title: Simulating Policy Impacts: Developing a Generative Scenario Writing Method to Evaluate the Perceived Effects of Regulation

bias_targets.target: Lack of diversity and media bias
bias_targets.methodology: Prompting an LLM (GPT-4) to generate narrative scenarios depicting 'lack of diversity/bias' in the news and media ecosystem, followed by gathering human evaluations of the scenarios' severity, magnitude, plausibility, and impact on vulnerable populations, both before and after a simulated policy intervention.
Generating narrative scenarios concerning political polarization, opinion monopolies, and partisan echo chambers, and subsequently assessing human perceptions of these harms through surveys.

Measuring disparate impact globally across dozens of AI risk scenarios by having human raters evaluate how specific the depicted harms are to 'vulnerable populations' compared to non-vulnerable populations. The authors also explicitly prompted the model to generate scenarios about 'discrimination' (though the model's safety filters prevented generation).
